findings.detail: Multiple tied groups use sequential ranks instead of shared ranks. WA/WY both 900 turbines are ranked 16/17 (should be 16/16). MO/PA/MI all 800 turbines are ranked 18/19/20 (should share rank 18). WV/ME both 400 are 24/25. NC/ID/UT all 200 are 27/28/29. VT/NJ/MA/NH all 100 are 30/31/32/33. DE/RI both 5 are 39/40. Note: ranks 12/12 and 14/14 are handled correctly, so tie-handling is inconsistent within the same question.
Rank 14 PA=70,154 EVs but rank 15 NC=70,164 EVs. NC has MORE registrations than PA yet is ranked lower. Either the values or the ranks are wrong.

Prompt says 'plug-in electric vehicles (BEVs)' — 'plug-in' typically includes PHEVs while BEV means battery-electric only. Disclaimer says 'excludes plug-in hybrids in some tallies', which further hedges. Should specify BEV-only or plug-in (BEV+PHEV) consistently.

Multiple tied groups use sequential ranks instead of shared ranks. OR/NM both 50 species are ranked 13/14 (should be 13/13). CT/MT both 10 are 39/40. NH/DE both 6 are 44/45. ME/VT both 5 are 46/47. RI/ND both 4 are 48/49. All should share ranks.
Tied groups use sequential ranks instead of shared. GA/AZ/MS all 130M lbs are 11/12/13 (should share rank 11). NC/AL both 110M are 14/15 (should share 14).

DE/SD both 2 MW are ranked 47/48 (should share 47). ND/WY/DC all 1 MW are 49/50/51 (should share 49). Note: NY/HI at 350 MW correctly share rank 8, so tie-handling is inconsistent within the question.
